messages:
maria: Customer (ACME) reports 403 when calling /v1/rerank after SSO token refresh. Worked earlier today, broke after token rotation.

ida: Repro steps from customer:
1) SSO login -> IdP issues JWT
2) Call embeddings/generation -> OK
3) Call rerank -> 403 Forbidden (missing rerank entitlement)

maria: They pasted the decoded JWT payload (redacted):
```
{
  "sub": "svc_acme",
  "scope": "generation embeddings rerank\n",
  "exp": 1730000000
}
```

sam: Looks like there's a trailing newline in the `scope` claim (note the `\n`). Our scope splitter currently splits on whitespace and then filters exact scope names; the trailing newline produces an empty or malformed token entry and causes `rerank` to be dropped.

jordan: I can repro locally by constructing a token with the same `scope` string — rerank goes missing in claim parsing.

sam: Quick repro command we used:
```
echo '<jwt>' | cut -d'.' -f2 | base64 -d
```
Shows the `scope` with the trailing newline.

ida: Customer can't easily control the IdP formatting across their many apps; they'd prefer we handle tolerant parsing server-side.

maria: Escalating to eng-identity, assigning to @sam. Marking P0 since production traffic for rerank is affected.

sam: Triage notes:
- Root cause: trailing whitespace/newline inside `scope` claim causes empty entries after split
- Short-term mitigation: trim whitespace and filter out empty strings when parsing scopes
- Long-term: add unit tests for odd whitespace and nonprintable characters in claims

sam: I'll push a small parser patch and roll to staging.

auth-bot: deploy started: auth-proxy v1.2.3-staging -> in progress

jordan: Staging tests: with patched parser, rerank returns 200 for token with trailing `\n`. Embeddings/generation unaffected.

maria: Informing customer we deployed a fix to staging and will promote to prod after verification.

auth-bot: deploy started: auth-proxy v1.2.3 -> production

auth-bot: deploy success: auth-proxy v1.2.3

ida: Confirmed with customer: rerank now succeeds. They tested in prod and calls are green.

maria: Closing loop — will add a unit test and a short regression note to the release changelog.

sam: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-proxy/pull/482 (parser: trim & filter empty scopes)

maria: :white_check_mark: Thanks team!
